_comment: Risk register for route R1 (and R2 where stated). Likelihood (L) and impact (I) are author-assigned ratings based on the evidence inventory on a 1-5 scale; they are not measurements. code/route_model.py perturbs every rating by -1/0/+1 (probabilities 0.25/0.50/0.25) to test how stable the ranking is.

risks.name: Impurity profile and purge when crystallisation replaces preparative HPLC
risks.basis: The only disclosed purification of the N-functionalised product is preparative HPLC (WO2016/099393 Example Ib); crystallisation as the purging step is not demonstrated (R1-salt, condition evidence D).
risks.validation: Impurity mapping by LC-MS across stages; spiking and purge studies; ICH Q3A identification (0.10 %) and qualification (0.15 %) thresholds as the working limits for doses up to 2 g/day.

risks.name: Undisclosed upstream route to the vinyl bromide building block
risks.basis: The preparation of the N-Boc vinyl bromide is not described in the portion of WO2016/099393 examined; Wei 2000 gives two general approaches to the scaffold.
risks.validation: Define and test a route to the vinyl bromide (benzhydryl alcohol dehydration or an alternative); set the registered starting-material boundary under ICH Q11.

risks.name: Palladium residue control to the ICH Q3D limit
risks.basis: Pd Class 2B, oral PDE 100 ug/day; the product contains two amides and a basic nitrogen; no Pd data in the public record examined.
risks.validation: Pd quantification (ICP-MS) after coupling, scavenging and crystallisation; catalyst-loading screen.

risks.name: Performance of the Suzuki-Miyaura step on scale (conversion, protodebromination, boronic-acid homocoupling)
risks.basis: Example IV reports 0.533 g input and a crude product taken on; no yield or purity reported.
risks.validation: Design-of-experiments screen of catalyst, base, solvent and temperature at laboratory scale before any scale-up.

risks.name: Reductive amination: conversion, reaction time and solvent change from DCE
risks.basis: Example Ib: 2 days, 16 % isolated on 40 mg; solvent alternatives to DCE have general precedent only.
risks.validation: Solvent and reductant screen (THF, acetonitrile, ester solvents), in-process control of conversion, quench and gas-evolution assessment.

risks.name: Regulatory change of route after clinical supply (comparability) and starting-material designation
risks.basis: ICH Q11 requires justification of starting materials and of changes in the manufacturing process; the clinical route is not public.
risks.validation: Early regulatory-strategy review; comparability plan for the drug substance.

risks.name: Thermal and gas-evolution hazards (Boc cleavage, borohydride quench, coupling exotherm)
risks.basis: General process-safety considerations for the reaction classes involved; no calorimetric data for these substrates.
risks.validation: Reaction calorimetry and thermal-stability screening before any scale above laboratory scale.

risks.name: Control of potentially mutagenic impurities (alkylating agents, residual aldehyde)
risks.basis: If a 5-(halomethyl)thiazole were used for N-alkylation it would be an alkylating agent to be assessed under ICH M7; the aldehyde route avoids it.
risks.validation: ICH M7 assessment of reagents, intermediates and likely impurities; purge-factor argument.

risks.name: Polymorph and residual-solvent control of the hydrochloride at scale
risks.basis: WO2022/013153 describes Forms HCl2/HCl3 and the problem of residual solvent in amorphous material; no scale reported.
risks.validation: Crystallisation development, XRPD, residual-solvent and hygroscopicity testing.

risks.name: Supply and quality of the thiazole and aryl building blocks
risks.basis: No supplier or price data were collected for this paper; the rating is an assumption.
risks.validation: Supplier survey and qualification; dual sourcing where possible.

risks.name: Compatibility of a thiazole-bearing, basic substrate with Pd coupling (route R2 only)
risks.basis: Hypothesis: heteroatom donors may coordinate palladium; not evaluated here.
risks.validation: Small-scale coupling of the N-substituted vinyl bromide against the Boc-protected one.

risks.name: Long-term supply concentration and geopolitical exposure for critical raw materials
risks.basis: Assumption; no supply-chain data were collected.
risks.validation: Dual-source qualification and strategic safety stock at the commercialisation stage.
